{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric by removing commas
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute total revenue from completed, non-test orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Ensure the premises are verified
premise_1 = (sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum() == 6
premise_2 = sales['status'].isin(['completed', 'refunded']).all()
premise_3 = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',').any()

# Print the results
premise_1, premise_2, premise_3, total_revenue"}
